conclusion.statement: Drafted requester-facing message: “Dear Requester: I cannot responsibly state an exact dollar amount for Laura Kensington’s 2022 federal tax from Summit’s June 20, 2022 building sale. The diligence memo states that an ineligible-shareholder transfer on June 1, 2022 caused an automatic termination of S-corporation status and that, without corrective action, Summit may be treated as a C corporation beginning June 1, 2022. The transaction document also acknowledges uncertainty concerning the validity of Summit’s S-corporation election.”
